periods.time: vol-11 ch-001 morning of the Seven Stars final day

name.zh: 七星决赛日的人潮与破军学生会抵达
name.en: Final-day crowds and Hagun student council arrival

periods.location: Osaka Bay Dome station district and Kanata's hotel route
periods.summary: The Bay Dome area fills with unprecedented crowds for the delayed Seven Stars final between Ikki and Stella. Renren, Saijo, Utakata and Kanata meet at the station, discuss the special postponement after Ikki's cardiac arrest, and debate whether Stella's overwhelming dragon power or Ikki's impossible technique will win.
periods.cause: Ikki survives Amane's post-semifinal attack but remains asleep until the final day, causing officials and spectators to wait for the promised final.
periods.outcome: The public mood shifts from anxiety to expectation; Hagun's student council becomes a witness group for the final.
periods.significance: Frames the final as a national event and shows even former opponents and schoolmates treating Ikki's participation as essential.
